title: The local dynamical structure of $Δ^*$ sets via a new Furstenberg family algebra
summary: In this paper, we strengthen the connection between the combinatorics of difference sets and the dynamics of group rotations. Our main result shows that sets which have non-empty intersection with all difference subsets of a commutative semigroup possess local Bohr structure. This generalizes results of Bergelson, Furstenberg, and Weiss and Host and Kra from the integers to arbitrary commutative semigroups.
